title: Technology Strategic Plan
provenance: Synthetic academic example; not an actual agency policy or authoritative guidance.

sections.heading: Reliable services
sections.passage: Objective 1: Maintain reliable and recoverable public services through controlled maintenance, tested recovery capabilities and reduced operational disruption.

sections.heading: Security and trust
sections.passage: Objective 2: Reduce security risk by enforcing least privilege, multifactor authentication, controlled vendor access and documented security decisions.

sections.heading: Responsible investment
sections.passage: Objective 3: Align technology investments with documented business needs, lifecycle affordability, interoperability and accountable procurement.
